answer: A bond is refunded only after 44 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The crystal counter is kept in basalt and island makes public each reset. An copycat therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 44 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3374 identities would post 796 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
